name: International Business Machines (IBM)
story: IBM supplied New Zealand Treasury with an IBM 650 data-processing system. Installed in 1960, it used magnetic tape and processed the central public-service payroll, returning printed vouchers and punched-card cheques.

sources.label: A. C. Shailes, “The impact of computers on the public sector” (1980), ITPNZ history
Brian E. Carpenter, “The First Computer in New Zealand”
